doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

title: Yesterday's parade and its bands
summary: Laine describes a parade he belonged to a company for, with about fifteen bands, wonderful and drink-filled.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Oh, boy, wonderful. You didn't go over there? No, I was wishing I could go over there. I wish I had come over there. I wish I had now too. I would have sent you home on your head. Oh, man, oh, man. Beer, whiskey and wine was bloated.
I can't take all that stuff. Did they have a band?
Did they have a band? They had music? Oh, no, no. I belong to one of the companies that did that parade. But didn't they have any music? No, Crockett. See, I belong to that. Did they have any music?
You see here, you know what you tell me? They tell you the truth.
I thought you said, did I play? Oh, no, I knew you didn't play. Uh-uh. No, I knew you wouldn't play. They weren't a chance.
